description:
Cost of drone crop spraying for the buyer's field: every published per-acre, per-hectare, per-mu (China) and per-10-are (Japan) drone spraying rate in the dataset x area x passes, with the best-matching rate for the country (national, recent first), the same-country span, flags taken from the source (chemicals extra, minimum area, starting price, older than 12 months) and every rate's source_url and as_of. Same maths as whirrwork.com/tools/drone-spraying-cost/. Only unit conversion (1 ha = 2.4710538 acres = 15 mu = 10 x 10 a); currencies are NEVER converted. Not a quote and not a Whirrwork estimate: say so. If country_has_rates is false, say there is no published rate for that country rather than borrowing one.
Examples: {"area":100,"unit":"acre","country":"US"}; {"area":40,"unit":"ha","passes":3,"country":"BR"}; {"area":250,"unit":"ha","country":"CN"}.

area.description: Field area in the chosen unit

language.description: Language for use-case text (machine-translated; English is authoritative). Default en.

own_rate.description: A rate the buyer was quoted, per chosen unit, to compare

rate_index.description: Use this published rate (index from rates[].index) as the headline instead of the automatic pick

unit.description: Area unit (default: the unit of the best-matching rate)

name: estimate_drone_spraying_cost

selected.description: Best-matching published rate for the country (null when none applies)

title: Drone spraying cost for a field
